Fast JSON utilities for nim_express using direct_engine (cursor-based, SIMD-accelerated serializer) from nim_fastjson.

For low-level DOM/cursor parsing use nim_fastjson/simdjson directly.

Serialize obj into a thread-local reusable buffer and return it as a borrowed string.Serialize obj to a fresh JSON string using the direct engine.Deserialize JSON text json into a value of type T.Deserialize JSON text json into the type given by the typedesc parameter.Serialize obj to a fresh JSON string.Deserialize JSON text json into the type given by the typedesc parameter.Deserialize json into T, returning default when parsing fails.Deserialize json into an Option, yielding none when parsing fails.Build a JSON error body containing msg.Build a JSON message body containing msg.Build a JSON status body containing status.Build a JSON data envelope containing data.Build a JSON success envelope containing data.Build a JSON list envelope with items and count for items.
